Initial release of the short video script generator skill.

- Generates engaging, platform-optimized short video scripts for social media (WeChat, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, TikTok, Reels)
- Includes detailed script structures for various durations with section breakdowns
- Provides platform-specific content style guidance and optimization tips
- Offers hook formulas, CTA suggestions, and engagement triggers
- Features a full production and content creation workflow with templates and user psychology insights
